edits.rationale: Hand-authored Tier 1 edit: raise the marketing-plan/referral-reward age exclusion from under 18 to under 21, an 'lt' predicate weakening (more users are excluded).
Hand-authored Tier 1 edit: raise the parental-consent age threshold for children's personal information from under 13 to under 14, an 'lt' predicate weakening (more users require consent).
